title: Beta Graphics
description: This 1.12.2 mod replicates beta 1.7.3's graphical engine.
body:
All visual features from beta 1.7.3 are now ported.

**Pairs well with:** [Modern Beta Forge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/modern-beta-forge)

**Includes:** 1.7.3's gamma levels, white lighting, texures, sounds, semi-transparent leaves, 2D items, distance fog, sunset lighting and skybox.

![gargamel](https://i.postimg.cc/hGGGhx02/2026-02-22-19-02-24.png)

**Requirements:** [Improved Cleanroom Relauncher](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/improved-cleanroom-relauncher) and [Fugue](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fugue)
